0.title: Meet PocketCare
0.body: Your calm money companion — track spending, plan ahead, and reach your goals, all in one private place that works offline.

1.title: Start here: add your accounts
1.body: Add your bank, cash and cards so PocketCare knows your starting balances. This one step powers everything else — your net worth, budgets and insights.

2.title: Log money in seconds
2.body: Record what you spend or earn — type it, or just tap the mic and say it out loud. PocketCare even suggests the category for you.

3.title: Know where it goes
3.body: Set simple budgets that nudge you early, and see clear, beautiful insights into where your money actually goes each month.

4.title: Plan what's coming
4.body: Salary, rent, bills, EMIs and subscriptions in one view — so upcoming payments never take you by surprise.

5.title: Reach your goals
5.body: Build an emergency buffer first, then set money aside for what matters and see exactly when you'll get there.

6.title: Not sure? Just ask
6.body: Ask PocketCare in plain words — "where did my money go?", "can I afford this?" — and it'll answer or take you right to the screen.

footer: Create an account to sync across devices. Guest data stays on this device and is kept for 3 days.

intro.title: Welcome to PocketCare
intro.p1: PocketCare is your private money diary. You write down what you spend and earn, and it shows you where your money is actually going.
intro.p2: It is not connected to your bank.
intro.p3: We never ask for your bank login, card number or OTP, and we can't see your bank at all.
intro.p4: Nothing is tracked automatically — you'll type your spends in yourself. That's deliberate: the few seconds it takes is what makes you notice where your money goes, and noticing is the whole point.

acc.title: Where do you keep your money?
acc.p1: An "account" here is just your own note of somewhere money sits — your bank, the cash in your purse, a credit card. It's a name and a number you type. Nothing is linked to the real bank.
acc.p2: Start with the one you use most. You can add others later.
acc.balLabel: Roughly how much is in it now?
acc.balHelp: An approximate number is fine — you can correct it any time.

spend.title: Now write down one thing you spent
spend.p1: Think of the last thing you paid for — tea, groceries, a bill.
spend.p2: When you record a spend, PocketCare subtracts it from that account, so the number stays true to real life.
spend.p3: This is the one habit that matters — everything else in the app is built from it.

done.title: That's it — you're set up
done.budgetBody: Set a monthly limit and PocketCare tells you when to slow down.
done.privacy: Your data is yours. It stays on your device and in your private account — we don't share it, and nobody else can see it.

insights.title: PocketCare reads your entries back to you
insights.p1: Once you've written a few things down, PocketCare starts pointing things out on its own: which category is eating the most, a month running hotter than the last, a subscription you may have forgotten.
insights.eg: "You've spent 32% more on eating out this month than last."
insights.p2: You don't have to build a single chart or spreadsheet. The more you write down, the more it has to tell you.

ask.title: Or just ask, in your own words
ask.p1: Type or say things like "how much did I spend on groceries last month?" or "can I afford ₹15,000 this week?" — and it answers from your own entries.
ask.p2: No menus to learn. If you'd rather ask a question than hunt for a screen, this is the shortcut.
ask.privacy: It only ever reads your own entries, and nothing is sent anywhere until you ask it something.

guest.title: You're using PocketCare as a guest
guest.p1: Your entries live only on this device, and guest data is deleted after a few days. Create a free account to keep it — and you'll get 14 days with everything unlocked.
